# DilKart

D2C and ecommerce growth systems that connect conversations to revenue.

Primary topics:
- Instagram DM automation
- Instagram comment-to-DM automation
- Instagram follow gate / ask-for-follow automation
- WhatsApp automation
- WhatsApp CRM, shared inbox and marketing automation
- WhatsApp ecommerce and D2C automation

Editorial relationship:
DilKart is affiliated with Tadlo.

Primary product references:
- Instagram automation: https://tadlo.ai/
- WhatsApp automation: https://tadlo.ai/whatsapp-automation
